'''2017 US Nationals Josh Mack LS Combat Preparedness (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Josh Mack]] at [[2017 U.S. National Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Josh Mack]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 U.S. National Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Jakku|V4-L-jakku.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Combat Preparedness (V) Mack LS.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125443/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/tournament-decklists.html Internet Archive]
